name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Trump raises concerns in call with Rep. Max Miller amid abuse allegations
changes.summary: Ohio Rep. Max Miller's reelection campaign has been upended by allegations Miller assaulted his ex-wife, Emily Moreno, and their 2-year-old daughter.

changes.title: DNC report on 2024 election outcome missing key chapter, report says
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with the New York Times' Shane Goldmacher about a missing chapter of the Democratic National Committee's report on Donald Trump's 2024 election win.

changes.title: Pirro Meets With Trump at the White House After He Said She ‘Choked’ in Reflecting Pool Case
changes.summary: President Trump said Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for Washington, D.C., “folded like an umbrella.” For now, her job appeared to be safe, according to two people familiar with the meeting.

changes.title: How the War in Iran Is Complicating Trump’s Agenda at Home
changes.summary: As President Trump heads to the West Coast to talk to Americans about the economy, the war in Iran is driving up costs and polls show the already unpopular conflict is losing support.

changes.title: They're a world leader in using drones for healthcare. But drones can't do it all
changes.summary: Drones carrying medical supplies constantly crisscross the skies of Rwanda. The Trump administration is giving a major grant to the effort — and at the same time cutting aid to the country. (Image credit: Claire Harbage/NPR).

changes.title: Trump and White House officials hope Rep. Max Miller ends reelection bid, sources say
changes.summary: President Trump and other officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits the congressional race in Ohio immediately, multiple U.S. officials familiar with the matter tell CBS News. CBS News' Taurean Small has more.

changes.title: Behind closed doors, Trump, White House aides hope Rep. Max Miller exits race
changes.summary: Some White House officials hope embattled GOP Rep. Max Miller exits his congressional race immediately, and President Trump has expressed a similar sentiment, multiple sources say.

changes.title: An Emerging Deal Between Iran and Oman to Reopen Hormuz Would Come at a Cost for Trump
changes.summary: The deal would address President Trump’s most urgent political problem by allowing ships to move again. But it would give Iran strategic leverage it did not have before the war.

changes.title: 8/3: The Takeout with Major Garrett
changes.summary: Trump says he's giving Iran a "last chance" at diplomacy; Blanche one step closer to confirmation as attorney general.

changes.title: Trump says Jeanine Pirro "choked" in dropping Reflecting Pool cases
changes.summary: "She folded like an umbrella," President Trump said of Jeanine Pirro, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia.
